The added release rule checks document identity and, where defined, the declared profile version.

Additional 2.1.0 checks cover the MCS/NPU measurement code systems, body section cardinality, international template and legalAuthenticator cardinality. Value-set membership, all header/body constraints and narrative semantics remain incomplete.

rulesets.label: PHMR-DK 1.3
rulesets.sourceSection: Guide updated 2 March 2020, methodCode table p. 79; published example for optional profile declaration
rulesets.documentVersionMarker: phmr-v1.3 (when present; not mandated by the guide)
coverageNotes: Existing XSD, Schematron and Gazelle checks are reused; their full correspondence to this release has not been audited.
Checks document template, rejects conflicting declared PHMR releases, and enforces two observation methodCode elements.
The published example declares phmr-v1.3, but the guide does not require a release declaration. Documents without one cannot be identified conclusively as 1.3; the target is chosen explicitly.
Source-derived conformance checks are described in docs/cda-conformance.md; unimplemented and ambiguous clauses remain outside coverage.

rulesets.label: QRD-DK 1.3.2
coverageNotes: Existing XSD, Schematron and Gazelle checks are reused; their full correspondence to this release has not been audited.
The added release rule checks document identity and, where defined, the declared profile version.
The qrd-v1.3 marker does not distinguish patch releases. 1.3.2 is the selected target; full validation of patch-specific constraints remains incomplete.

Additional source-traced header, section, entry, datatype, relationship and reference checks are in the conformance Schematron. See docs/pro-conformance.md for coverage and unresolved specification conflicts; external registries, rendering and paired-document semantics are not certified.
